tool_schemas.name: search_flights
tool_schemas.description: Creates or reuses (via client_request_id) a flight search session from the provided segment_criteria and passenger/cabin inputs, requests results from the flight provider, persists the normalized criteria and returned offers, and returns the stored session with its offers for the requested currency/locale. This endpoint does not page results; it returns the full set of offers captured for the session. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing or malformed (including invalid cabin_class, non-integer/negative counts, or invalid segment_criteria), UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to create searches, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are reached, and PROVIDER_ERROR when the upstream provider request fails or times out.

client_request_id.description: Idempotency key for the search request from the client.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code to price offers in (e.g., USD).

preferred_airlines.description: List of preferred airline IATA codes to prioritize/filter.

excluded_airlines.description: List of excluded airline IATA codes to filter out.

flex_days.description: Flexible date search window in days (applied around requested dates).

segment_criteria.description: Flight segment search criteria used to build provider request (e.g., origin, destination, departure date).

tool_schemas.name: get_offer_details
tool_schemas.description: Returns the cached, normalized details for a previously stored flight offer (identified by offer_id), including the provider payload captured during search and any downstream detail/review fetches already recorded for that offer. This endpoint does not page results; it returns a single offer detail record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when offer_id does not match the required format, NOT_FOUND when no cached offer exists for the given offer_id (or it is not accessible to the caller), and UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to read offer details.

offer_id.description: Internal flight offer id (from flight_offers.id) to fetch cached details for.

tool_schemas.name: search_multi_city
tool_schemas.description: Creates or reuses (via client_request_id) a multi-city flight search session using the ordered segment_criteria array, persists the normalized criteria, stores the provider’s returned offers, and returns the stored session with its offers priced in the requested currency/locale. This endpoint does not page results; it returns the full set of offers captured for the session. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when inputs are missing or malformed (including invalid cabin_class, passenger counts, or segment_criteria), UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to create searches, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are reached, and PROVIDER_ERROR when the upstream provider request fails or times out.

client_request_id.description: Idempotency key for the search request from the client.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code to price offers in (e.g., USD).

preferred_airlines.description: List of preferred airline IATA codes to prioritize/filter.

excluded_airlines.description: List of excluded airline IATA codes to filter out.

flex_days.description: Flexible date search window in days (applied around requested dates).

segment_criteria.description: Ordered list of flight segments for a multi-city itinerary.

tool_schemas.name: search_stays
tool_schemas.description: Creates or reuses (via client_request_id) a stay search session for the given destination and date range, persists the normalized criteria, stores the provider’s returned stay properties/results (filtered by the supplied price, star_ratings, and amenities constraints), and returns the stored session with its results in the requested currency/locale. This endpoint does not page results; it returns the full set of stay properties captured for the session. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing or malformed (including invalid datetimes, check_out_date not after check_in_date, non-integer/negative counts, or invalid price bounds), UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to create searches, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are reached, and PROVIDER_ERROR when the upstream provider request fails or times out.

client_request_id.description: Idempotency key for the search request from the client.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code to price stays in (e.g., USD).

destination.description: Normalized destination object used by the stay provider (e.g., city/region ids, coordinates).

check_in_date.description: Check-in datetime (stored as datetime in backend).

check_out_date.description: Check-out datetime (stored as datetime in backend).

star_ratings.description: Allowed hotel star ratings to filter by.

tool_schemas.name: get_stay_reviews
tool_schemas.description: Returns the cached review summary and review items previously fetched for a stored stay property (identified by stay_property_id). This endpoint does not page results; it returns the complete cached review set for the property as stored. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when stay_property_id does not match the required format, NOT_FOUND when no cached stay property/reviews exist for the given id (or it is not accessible to the caller), and UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to read stay reviews.

stay_property_id.description: Internal stay property id (from stay_properties.id) to fetch cached reviews for.

tool_schemas.name: list_search_sessions
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored search sessions visible to the caller, optionally filtered by session_type/status/provider/client_request_id, and ordered by most recently created. Returns a paginated page of session records. Refuses invalid filter combinations and rejects requests without valid authentication.

api_key.description: Service API key used to authenticate the caller.

client_request_id.description: Filter to sessions created/reused with the given idempotency key.

created_at_gte.description: Only return sessions created at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

created_at_lte.description: Only return sessions created at or before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return per page.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

tool_schemas.name: get_search_session
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single search session by id, including its persisted request criteria and the currently stored offers/properties associated to its request. Refuses access to sessions the caller is not entitled to and returns NOT_FOUND when the id does not exist.

api_key.description: Service API key used to authenticate the caller.

include_results.description: When true, includes associated flight_offers or stay_properties; when false, returns only session and request metadata.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_search_session
tool_schemas.description: Cancels an in-flight search session by transitioning status created->cancelled or running->cancelled, and records the cancellation in audit fields. Refuses cancellation for completed/failed/expired/cancelled sessions and returns the updated session record.

api_key.description: Service API key used to authenticate the caller.

reason.description: Optional human-readable cancellation reason for auditing.

tool_schemas.name: expire_search_session
tool_schemas.description: Forces a completed or failed search session to transition to expired (completed|failed->expired) and prevents it from being used to serve cached results unless explicitly allowed by configuration. Refuses if the session is not eligible for expiration and returns the updated session record.

api_key.description: Service API key used to authenticate the caller.

force.description: When true, expires the session even if expires_at is in the future; when false, refuses unless now() >= expires_at.

tool_schemas.name: list_flight_offers
tool_schemas.description: Lists flight offers stored for a given search session or flight_search_request, optionally filtered by offer status. Returns a paginated page of offers with normalized pricing fields and identifiers. Refuses requests for expired sessions unless explicitly allowed by configuration and rejects invalid ids.

api_key.description: Service API key used to authenticate the caller.

session_id.description: Filter offers by search session id.

flight_search_request_id.description: Filter offers by flight_search_requests.id (must belong to the same session_id if both are provided).

limit.description: Maximum number of offers to return per page.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

tool_schemas.name: get_whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity associated with the provided credential, including granted scopes and current quota/rate-limit consumption for this service. Refuses invalid or revoked credentials.

api_key.description: Service API key used to authenticate the caller.
